desc: An elite member of Takigakure village, one of the members of "Akatsuki". Partner of Hidan, possesses the secret jutsu "Earth Grudge Fear", allowing him to control black tendrils from within his body using chakra to steal others' hearts
desc_vn: Một thành viên ưu tú của làng Takigakure, một trong những thành viên của "Akatsuki". Đồng đội của Hidan, sở hữu bí thuật "Địa Oán Ngu", có thể điều khiển xúc tu đen giải phóng từ bên trong cơ thể bằng cách sử dụng chakra, từ đó cướp đoạt trái tim của người khác.
desc_ma: Seorang ahli elit dari kampung Takigakure, salah satu anggota "Akatsuki". Rakan kepada Hidan, memiliki jutsu rahsia "Jiongu" yang boleh mengawal sesungut hitam yang keluar dari tubuhnya menggunakan chakra untuk merampas jantung orang lain
desc_en: An elite member of Takigakure village, one of the members of "Akatsuki". Partner of Hidan, possesses the secret jutsu "Earth Grudge Fear", allowing him to control black tendrils from within his body using chakra to steal others' hearts
desc_th: สมาชิกคนสำคัญของหมู่บ้านทาคิงาคุเระ หนึ่งในสมาชิกของ "แสงอุษา" เป็นคู่หูของฮิดัน ผู้ใช้วิชาลับ "จิโอะอังงู" ที่สามารถควบคุมหนวดสีดำที่พุ่งออกมาจากร่างกายด้วยจักระ และขโมยหัวใจของผู้อื่น
desc_in: Anggota elit dari desa Takigakure, salah satu anggota "Akatsuki". Rekan Hidan, pemilik jutsu rahasia "Jiongu", yang dapat mengendalikan tentakel hitam yang keluar dari tubuhnya menggunakan chakra, untuk mencuri jantung orang lain
desc_ph: Isang kilalang miyembro ng nayon ng Takigakure, isa sa mga kasapi ng "Akatsuki". Katuwang ni Hidan, taglay ang lihim na jutsu na "Jiongu", na kayang kontrolin ang mga itim na galamay mula sa kanyang katawan gamit ang chakra upang nakawin ang puso ng iba

name: Naruto Uzumaki (Teen)
name_th: นารูโตะ อุซึมากิ (วัยเด็ก)

name_th: ซากุระ ฮารุโนะ (วัยเด็ก)

name_th: เนจิ ฮิวงะ (วัยเด็ก)
desc: Known as the genius of the Hyuga clan, though his Byakugan abilities were restricted by the Main Family, he inherited techniques like “Heavenly Rotation” thanks to his natural talent

name_th: คิบะ อินุซึกะ (วัยเด็ก)

name_th: คิบะ อินุซึกะ
desc: A chunin from the Leaf Village, Land of Fire, son of Tsume Inuzuka, head of the Inuzuka clan. Skilled in working with his ninja dog Akamaru, most used jutsu is “Fang Over Fang”, with a competitive, impulsive, and confident personality, likes to lead

desc_ma: Chunin dari Kampung Daun, Negara Api, anak kepada Tsume Inuzuka, ketua klan Inuzuka. Mahir bekerjasama dengan anjing ninja Akamaru, jurus yang paling biasa digunakan ialah “Taring Berpusing”, bersifat suka bersaing, gopoh dan yakin diri, suka menjadi pemimpin

desc_ph: Chunin mula sa Nayon ng Dahon, Bansa ng Apoy, anak ni Tsume Inuzuka, pinuno ng Inuzuka clan. Magaling sa pakikipagtulungan kay Akamaru, ang kanyang ninjutsu ay "Fang Over Fang", may pagkakumpitensiya, padalos-dalos, at gusto maging lider

chattext2_ph: Hindi ko rin pwedeng laging ipaubaya sa iba ang pagprotekta sa akin!
chattext3_vn: Ta sẽ không sợ hãi nữa...ta sẽ dùng nắm đấm của mình, đánh gục tổ chức Akatsuki!

chattext3_ph: Hindi na ako matatakot...gagamitin ko ang kamao ko para talunin ang Akatsuki!

name_th: คาบูโตะ (นักสู้)
desc: Lost his memory due to childhood injury, was adopted by Medical Ninja Nono, director of an orphanage. Later followed Danzo voluntarily to protect Nono and the orphanage after Danzo threatened her, becoming a ninja operating in Konoha.

desc_en: Lost his memory due to childhood injury, was adopted by Medical Ninja Nono, director of an orphanage. Later followed Danzo voluntarily to protect Nono and the orphanage after Danzo threatened her, becoming a ninja operating in Konoha.

desc_in: Kehilangan ingatan akibat cedera masa kecil, diadopsi oleh Yakushi Nono, kepala panti asuhan. Namun karena ancaman dari Danzo, ia rela mengikuti Danzo demi melindungi Nono dan panti asuhan, menjadi ninja Konoha
desc_ph: Nawala ang alaala dahil sa sugat noong bata pa, inampon ni Yakushi Nono ng ampunan, ngunit pumayag sumama kay Danzo para maprotektahan si Nono at ang mga ulila

name_th: ซาบุซะ โมโมะจิ
desc: One of the Second Generation Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist Village, Water Country, second wielder of the Executioner’s Blade. Nicknamed “Demon Man,” ambitious and ruthless, but not heartless.

name: Temari
name_th: เทมาริ
desc: A kunoichi from the Sand Village, eldest daughter of the Fourth Kazekage Rasa, older sister of the Fifth Kazekage Gaara and Kankuro. Frank in nature, expert in using her giant fan to perform large-scale Wind Release ninjutsu.
desc_vn: Nữ ninja làng Cát, con gái lớn của Đệ Tứ Kazekage Rasa, chị gái của Đệ Ngũ Kazekage Gaara và Kankuro. Tính cách thẳng thắn, giỏi sử dụng quạt ba sao để tấn công tầm xa diện rộng bằng nhẫn thuật phong độn.
desc_ma: Kunoichi dari Kampung Pasir, anak sulung Kazekage Keempat Rasa, kakak kepada Kazekage Kelima Gaara dan Kankuro. Jujur dan mahir menggunakan kipas besar untuk serangan elemen angin jarak jauh.
desc_en: A kunoichi from the Sand Village, eldest daughter of the Fourth Kazekage Rasa, older sister of the Fifth Kazekage Gaara and Kankuro. Frank in nature, expert in using her giant fan to perform large-scale Wind Release ninjutsu.
desc_th: คุโนะอิจิแห่งหมู่บ้านทราย บุตรสาวคนโตของคาเซคาเงะรุ่นที่ 4 ราสะ พี่สาวของกะระและคันคุโร่ นิสัยตรงไปตรงมา ใช้พัดสามแฉกในการโจมตีระยะไกลด้วยวิชาลม
desc_in: Kunoichi Desa Pasir, putri sulung Kazekage Keempat Rasa, kakak Gaara dan Kankuro. Jujur, ahli menggunakan kipas tiga bintang untuk serangan elemen angin jarak jauh
desc_ph: Kunoichi ng Nayon ng Buhangin, panganay na anak ni Kazekage Rasa, ate nina Gaara at Kankuro. Prangka, gumagamit ng malaking pamaypay para sa malawakang Wind Release

name: Tian Dai
name_th: เทียนไต้
desc: Advisor of the Sand Village, a puppet master capable of manipulating puppets with a single finger, and a versatile kunoichi skilled in taijutsu, medical ninjutsu, and sealing techniques.
desc_vn: Cố vấn của Làng Cát, một bậc thầy rối siêu hạng có thể điều khiển rối chỉ bằng một ngón tay, đồng thời là một nữ ninja toàn năng sở hữu thể thuật, nhẫn thuật y thuật và phong ấn thuật mạnh mẽ.
desc_ma: Penasihat Kampung Pasir, pakar boneka yang boleh kendali boneka hanya dengan satu jari, juga kunoichi serba boleh dengan taijutsu, ninjutsu penyembuh dan jutsu meterai kuat.
desc_en: Advisor of the Sand Village, a puppet master capable of manipulating puppets with a single finger, and a versatile kunoichi skilled in taijutsu, medical ninjutsu, and sealing techniques.
desc_th: ที่ปรึกษาหมู่บ้านทราย ปรมาจารย์เชิดหุ่น ผู้สามารถควบคุมหุ่นด้วยนิ้วเดียว เป็นคุโนะอิจิรอบด้านผู้ชำนาญวิชาแพทย์ วิชาต่อสู้ และวิชาผนึก
desc_in: Penasihat Desa Pasir, ahli pengendali boneka tingkat tinggi yang bisa menggerakkan boneka hanya dengan satu jari, kunoichi serba bisa dengan kemampuan taijutsu, ninjutsu medis, dan jutsu segel yang kuat
desc_ph: Tagapayo ng Nayon ng Buhangin, mahusay na puppeteer na kayang gumalaw ng papet gamit lang isang daliri, isang all-around kunoichi na bihasa sa taijutsu, ninjutsu medikal, at teknik ng selyo
unlockDesc_vn: Phân phối sự kiện đặc biệt
unlockDesc_th: การแจกจ่ายกิจกรรมพิเศษ
chattext1_vn: Đúng là tên ngốc!
chattext1: What an idiot!
chattext1_ma: Betul-betul bodoh!
chattext1_en: What an idiot!
chattext1_th: เจ้านี่มันโง่จริงๆ!
chattext1_in: Benar-benar bodoh!
chattext1_ph: Totoo ngang isa kang tanga!
chattext2_vn: Với ta, ngươi chỉ là chú gà con mà thôi.
chattext2: To me, you’re nothing but a baby chick.
chattext2_ma: Bagi aku, kau hanyalah seekor anak ayam!
chattext2_en: To me, you’re nothing but a baby chick.
chattext2_th: สำหรับฉัน เจ้าเป็นแค่ลูกเจี๊ยบเท่านั้น
chattext2_in: Bagiku, kau hanyalah anak ayam
chattext2_ph: Sa akin, isa ka lang munting sisiw
chattext3_vn: Để ngươi thấy rõ chênh lệch kinh nghiệm thực chiến giữa chúng ta rốt cuộc thế nào.
chattext3: Let me show you the gap in combat experience between us!
chattext3_ma: Biar saya tunjukkan jurang pengalaman pertempuran antara kita!
chattext3_en: Let me show you the gap in combat experience between us!
chattext3_th: ให้เห็นถึงช่องว่างประสบการณ์ระหว่างเราสองคนอย่างชัดเจน
chattext3_in: Kau akan lihat seberapa besar perbedaan pengalaman tempur kita
chattext3_ph: Makikita mo ngayon kung gaano kalayo ang agwat ng karanasan natin sa laban

name: Xiao Nan
name_th: เซียวหนาน
desc: One of the founding members of "Akatsuki" and its only female member, codenamed "White Tiger," known as the “Angel.”
desc_vn: Một trong những người sáng lập tổ chức "Akatsuki", và là thành viên nữ duy nhất, mật danh "Bạch" (Bạch Hổ), được gọi là "Thiên sứ".
desc_ma: Salah seorang pengasas "Akatsuki", satu-satunya wanita dalam organisasi, kod nama "Shiro" (Harimau Putih), digelar "Malaikat".
desc_en: One of the founding members of "Akatsuki" and its only female member, codenamed "White Tiger," known as the “Angel.”
desc_th: หนึ่งในผู้ก่อตั้งแสงอุษา และเป็นสมาชิกหญิงเพียงคนเดียว โค้ดเนม “พยัคฆ์ขาว” เป็นที่รู้จักในนาม “เทวทูต”
desc_in: Salah satu pendiri "Akatsuki" dan satu-satunya anggota perempuan, nama sandi "Shiro" (Harimau Putih), dijuluki "Malaikat"
desc_ph: Isa sa mga tagapagtatag ng "Akatsuki" at nag-iisang babaeng miyembro, codename “Shiro” (Puting Tigre), tinatawag na “Anghel”
unlockDesc_vn: Phân phối sự kiện đặc biệt

chattext1_vn: Trước mặt Pain, mọi vật đều nhỏ bé tựa hạt bụi!
chattext1: Before Pain, everything is as small as dust!
chattext1_ma: Di hadapan Pain, segala-galanya kecil seperti debu!
chattext1_en: Before Pain, everything is as small as dust!
chattext1_th: ต่อหน้าเพน ทุกสิ่งเล็กจิ๋วเหมือนฝุ่นผง!
chattext1_in: Di hadapan Pain, segalanya kecil seperti debu!
chattext1_ph: Sa harap ni Pain, lahat ay kasing-liit ng alikabok!
chattext2_vn: Ngươi là bóng đêm! Trong thế giới không ánh sáng, đóa hoa đành héo úa!
chattext2: You are the darkness! In a world without light, flowers can only wither!
chattext2_ma: Kaulah kegelapan! Dalam dunia tanpa cahaya, bunga akan layu!
chattext2_en: You are the darkness! In a world without light, flowers can only wither!
chattext2_th: เจ้าเป็นความมืด! ในโลกที่ไร้แสงสว่าง ดอกไม้ย่อมเหี่ยวเฉา!
chattext2_in: Kau adalah kegelapan! Dalam dunia tanpa cahaya, bunga pun akan layu!
chattext2_ph: Ikaw ang kadiliman! Sa mundong walang liwanag, ang bulaklak ay nalalanta!
chattext3_vn: Chiếc cầu nối đến hòa bình...ta sẽ trở thành trụ cột của chúng!
chattext3: A bridge to peace... I’ll become its pillar!
chattext3_ma: Jambatan menuju keamanan... saya akan menjadi tiangnya!
chattext3_en: A bridge to peace... I’ll become its pillar!
chattext3_th: สะพานเชื่อมสู่สันติภาพ...ฉันจะเป็นเสาหลักให้มันเอง!
chattext3_in: Aku akan jadi pilar penghubung menuju perdamaian!
chattext3_ph: Ako ang magiging haligi ng tulay patungo sa kapayapaan!

name: Scorpion
name_th: แมงป่อง
desc: A member of "Akatsuki" with the codename "Jade." Celebrated as a puppet master prodigy, known as “Sasori of the Red Sand.”
desc_vn: Một trong những thành viên của "Akatsuki", mật danh Ngọc (Ngọc Nữ). Được ca ngợi là nhà tạo hình rối thiên tài, được biết đến với danh xưng "Sasori của Cát Đỏ".
desc_ma: Anggota "Akatsuki" dengan kod nama Gyoku (Permata). Dikenal sebagai genius pengendali boneka, digelar "Sasori dari Pasir Merah".
desc_en: A member of "Akatsuki" with the codename "Jade." Celebrated as a puppet master prodigy, known as “Sasori of the Red Sand.”
desc_th: สมาชิกของแสงอุษา โค้ดเนม “หยก” เป็นอัจฉริยะด้านหุ่นเชิด มีชื่อเสียงในนาม “ซาโซริแห่งทรายแดง”
desc_in: Salah satu anggota "Akatsuki", nama sandi Gyoku (Gadis Permata). Dikenal sebagai seniman boneka jenius, disebut sebagai “Sasori dari Pasir Merah”
desc_ph: Isa sa mga miyembro ng "Akatsuki", codename "Gyoku" (Batong Maharlika). Henyo sa paggawa ng papet, kilala bilang “Sasori ng Pulang Buhangin”

chattext1_vn: Chỉ vĩnh hằng bất hủ, mới có thể gọi là nghệ thuật.
chattext1: Only the eternal and immortal can be called true art.
chattext1_ma: Hanya yang kekal abadi layak dipanggil seni.
chattext1_en: Only the eternal and immortal can be called true art.
chattext1_th: มีเพียงความอมตะนิรันดร์เท่านั้น จึงจะเรียกว่าศิลปะ
chattext1_in: Hanya yang abadi dan tak tergantikan yang bisa disebut seni.
chattext1_ph: Tanging ang walang hanggang sining lamang ang tunay na sining!
chattext2_vn: Tư chất không tồi, nhưng kỹ thuật của ta còn cao minh hơn cả ngươi!
chattext2: Not bad talent, but my techniques far surpass yours!
chattext2_ma: Bakatmu bagus, tapi teknikku jauh lebih hebat!
chattext2_en: Not bad talent, but my techniques far surpass yours!
chattext2_th: พรสวรรค์ไม่เลว แต่เทคนิคของฉันยังเหนือกว่าเจ้า!
chattext2_in: Bakatmu tidak buruk, tapi teknikku jauh lebih unggul!
chattext2_ph: Magaling ang potensyal mo, pero mas mahusay pa rin ang kakayahan ko!
chattext3_vn: Ta đã quên đi ký ức, thứ ta cần bây giờ là nghệ thuật vĩnh hằng.
chattext3: I’ve forgotten my memories. What I seek now is eternal art.
chattext3_ma: Saya sudah lupa kenangan, apa yang saya cari sekarang adalah seni abadi.
chattext3_en: I’ve forgotten my memories. What I seek now is eternal art.
chattext3_th: ฉันลืมความทรงจำไปแล้ว สิ่งที่ฉันต้องการตอนนี้คือศิลปะนิรันดร์
chattext3_in: Aku telah melupakan ingatanku, yang kubutuhkan sekarang hanyalah seni abadi
chattext3_ph: Nakalimutan ko na ang alaala, ang kailangan ko ngayon ay walang hanggang sining

name: Shimura Danzo
name_th: ชิมูระ ดันโซ
desc: Leader of “Root” from the Hidden Leaf Village, Fire Country. In his youth, he was part of the elite guard of the Second Hokage.
desc_vn: Thủ lĩnh của "Root" thuộc làng Lá, Hỏa Quốc, khi còn trẻ là thành viên đội hộ vệ tinh nhuệ của Hokage Đệ Nhị.
desc_ma: Ketua "Root" dari Kampung Daun, Negara Api, dulunya ahli pasukan elit pengawal Hokage Kedua.
desc_en: Leader of “Root” from the Hidden Leaf Village, Fire Country. In his youth, he was part of the elite guard of the Second Hokage.
desc_th: ผู้นำกลุ่ม “Root” แห่งโคโนฮะ แคว้นไฟ เมื่อตอนยังเด็กเป็นหนึ่งในหน่วยพิทักษ์โฮคาเงะรุ่นที่ 2
desc_in: Pemimpin "Root" dari Desa Daun, Negara Api, dulunya anggota pasukan elit pengawal Hokage Kedua
desc_ph: Pinuno ng "Root" mula sa Nayon ng Dahon, Bansa ng Apoy, dating miyembro ng elite na yunit ng Ikalawang Hokage
unlockDesc_vn: Phân phối sự kiện đặc biệt
unlockDesc_th: การแจกจ่ายกิจกรรมพิเศษ
chattext1_vn: So với việc bảo vệ Làng Lá, thì tính mạng ngươi chỉ là con kiến mà thôi.
chattext1: Compared to protecting the Leaf Village, your life is like that of an ant.
chattext1_ma: Berbanding dengan melindungi Kampung Daun, nyawamu cuma umpama seekor semut.
chattext1_en: Compared to protecting the Leaf Village, your life is like that of an ant.
chattext1_th: เมื่อเทียบกับการปกป้องหมู่บ้านโคโนฮะ ชีวิตของเจ้าก็แค่ตัวมด
chattext1_in: Dibandingkan dengan melindungi Desa Daun, nyawamu hanyalah seekor semut.
chattext1_ph: Kumpara sa pagprotekta sa Konoha, ang buhay mo ay parang langgam lang.
chattext2_vn: Để ta đứng vào vị trí Hokage, sự hi sinh của ngươi là cần thiết.
chattext2: For me to become Hokage, your sacrifice is necessary.
chattext2_ma: Untuk aku menjadi Hokage, pengorbananmu diperlukan.
chattext2_en: For me to become Hokage, your sacrifice is necessary.
chattext2_th: เพื่อให้ฉันขึ้นเป็นโฮคาเงะ การเสียสละของเจ้าจำเป็นต้องเกิดขึ้น
chattext2_in: Agar aku bisa menjadi Hokage, pengorbananmu dibutuhkan
chattext2_ph: Para maging Hokage ako, kailangan ang sakripisyo mo
chattext3_vn: So với việc bảo vệ Làng Lá, tính mạng của ngươi thật sự nhỏ bé.
chattext3: Compared to protecting the Leaf Village, your life is truly insignificant.
chattext3_ma: Berbanding melindungi Hidden Leaf, nyawa kamu sangat kecil.
chattext3_en: Compared to protecting the Leaf Village, your life is truly insignificant.
chattext3_th: เมื่อเทียบกับการปกป้องหมู่บ้าน ความตายของแกมันเล็กน้อยนัก
chattext3_in: Dibandingkan dengan melindungi Desa Daun, nyawamu tidak seberapa
chattext3_ph: Kung ikukumpara sa Làng Lá, napakaliit ng halaga ng buhay mo

name: Sarutobi Asuma
name_th: ซารูโทบิ อาซึมะ
desc: Son of the Third Hokage Sarutobi Hiruzen, one of the top elite jonin of the Hidden Leaf Village, known for his close-combat prowess.
desc_vn: Con trai của Hokage Đệ Tam Sarutobi Hiruzen, một trong những jōnin ưu tú hàng đầu của Làng Lá thuộc Hỏa Quốc, nổi tiếng với khả năng cận chiến.
desc_ma: Anak lelaki Hokage Ketiga Hiruzen Sarutobi, salah seorang jonin terbaik Kampung Daun, dikenali dengan kemampuan tempur jarak dekat.
desc_en: Son of the Third Hokage Sarutobi Hiruzen, one of the top elite jonin of the Hidden Leaf Village, known for his close-combat prowess.
desc_th: บุตรชายของโฮคาเงะรุ่นที่ 3 ซารุโทบิ ฮิรุเซ็น เป็นหนึ่งในโจนินชั้นแนวหน้าของหมู่บ้านโคโนฮะ มีชื่อเสียงด้านการต่อสู้ระยะประชิด
desc_in: Putra Hokage Ketiga Sarutobi Hiruzen, salah satu jōnin terbaik Desa Daun, terkenal dengan kemampuan bertarung jarak dekat
desc_ph: Anak ni Hokage III Sarutobi Hiruzen, isa sa pinakamagaling na jōnin ng Nayon ng Dahon, kilala sa pakikipaglaban ng malapitan

chattext1_vn: Bảo vệ ngọc là sứ mệnh của ta!
chattext1: Protecting the jade is my mission!
chattext1_ma: Melindungi permata adalah misi aku!
chattext1_en: Protecting the jade is my mission!
chattext1_th: การปกป้องอัญมณีคือภารกิจของข้า!
chattext1_in: Melindungi permata adalah misi ku!
chattext1_ph: Ang pagbabantay sa jade ay ang aking misyon!
chattext2_vn: Không cần lo lắng, ta sẽ bảo vệ ngươi!
chattext2: Don’t worry, I’ll protect you!
chattext2_ma: Jangan risau, aku akan lindungimu!
chattext2_en: Don’t worry, I’ll protect you!
chattext2_th: ไม่ต้องกังวล ฉันจะปกป้องเจ้าเอง!
chattext2_in: Jangan khawatir, aku akan melindungimu!
chattext2_ph: Huwag kang mag-alala, poprotektahan kita!
chattext3_vn: Không cần lo lắng, ta sẽ bảo vệ ngươi!
chattext3: Don’t worry, I’ll protect you!
chattext3_ma: Jangan risau, saya akan lindungi kamu!
chattext3_en: Don’t worry, I’ll protect you!
chattext3_th: ไม่ต้องห่วง ฉันจะปกป้องแกเอง!
chattext3_in: Jangan khawatir, aku akan melindungimu!
chattext3_ph: Huwag kang mag-alala, poprotektahan kita!

name: Yamato
name_th: ยามาโตะ
desc: A Jonin of the Hidden Leaf Village, Fire Country, formerly an elite member of the Hokage's special Anbu unit. From the time of the Third Hokage, he was known as one of the top Anbu ninjas.
desc_vn: Thượng nhẫn của làng Lá thuộc Hỏa quốc, nguyên là thành viên ưu tú của đội ám bộ trực thuộc Hokage, từ thời Hokage đệ Tam đã được mệnh danh là ninja xuất sắc hàng đầu trong ám bộ.
desc_ma: Jonin dari Kampung Daun, Negara Api, mantan ahli elit Anbu bawah Hokage, sejak zaman Hokage Ketiga sudah terkenal sebagai ninja terbaik unit khas.
desc_en: A Jonin of the Hidden Leaf Village, Fire Country, formerly an elite member of the Hokage's special Anbu unit. From the time of the Third Hokage, he was known as one of the top Anbu ninjas.
desc_th: โจนินแห่งหมู่บ้านโคโนฮะ แคว้นไฟ อดีตสมาชิกหน่วยอันบุชั้นยอด เคยได้รับการยกย่องตั้งแต่ยุคโฮคาเงะรุ่นที่ 3 ว่าเป็นนินจาอันบุอันดับหนึ่ง
desc_in: Jōnin dari Desa Daun, Negara Api, mantan anggota elit pasukan bayangan langsung di bawah Hokage. Sejak zaman Hokage Ketiga sudah dijuluki sebagai ninja top dari Anbu
desc_ph: Jōnin mula sa Nayon ng Dahon, Bansa ng Apoy, dating miyembro ng elite Anbu na direktang sakop ng Hokage, isa sa mga pinakamagaling mula pa noong panahon ng Ikatlong Hokage

chattext1_vn: Ta sẽ không nương tay!
chattext1: I will show no mercy!
chattext1_ma: Aku tidak akan bertolak ansur!
chattext1_en: I will show no mercy!
chattext1_th: ข้าจะไม่ปรานี!
chattext1_in: Aku tidak akan menahan diri!
chattext1_ph: Hindi ako magdadalawang-isip!
chattext2_vn: Mokuton và ý chí lửa đều tiếp tục trong trái tim ta!
chattext2: Wood Release and the Will of Fire live on in my heart!
chattext2_ma: Mokuton dan semangat api terus hidup dalam hatiku!
chattext2_en: Wood Release and the Will of Fire live on in my heart!
chattext2_th: มุคุโตะและเจตจำนงแห่งไฟยังคงอยู่ในใจฉัน!
chattext2_in: Mokuton dan kehendak api terus hidup di dalam hatiku!
chattext2_ph: Ang Mokuton at ang kalooban ng apoy ay nasa puso ko pa rin!
chattext3_vn: Mokuton và ý chí lửa đều tiếp tục trong trái tim ta!
chattext3: Mokuton and the Will of Fire continue within my heart!
chattext3_ma: Mokuton dan Semangat Api terus membara dalam hati saya!
chattext3_en: Mokuton and the Will of Fire continue within my heart!
chattext3_th: มุคุโตนและเจตจำนงแห่งเพลิงยังคงสืบทอดในหัวใจของฉัน!
chattext3_in: Mokuton dan Kehendak Api tetap hidup dalam hatiku!
chattext3_ph: Ang Mokuton at ang Kalooban ng Apoy ay nasa puso ko pa rin!

name: Jiraiya
name_th: จิไรยะ
desc: One of the “Three Legendary Sannin” of the Hidden Leaf Village, Fire Country, disciple of the Third Hokage Sarutobi Hiruzen, and the person Naruto respects the most in his life.
desc_vn: Một trong "Tam nin" của làng Lá thuộc Hỏa quốc, đệ tử của Hokage đệ Tam Sarutobi Hiruzen, người mà Naruto kính trọng nhất trong cuộc đời.
desc_ma: Salah satu "Sannin" Kampung Daun, murid Hokage Ketiga Hiruzen Sarutobi, orang yang paling dihormati Naruto sepanjang hidupnya.
desc_en: One of the “Three Legendary Sannin” of the Hidden Leaf Village, Fire Country, disciple of the Third Hokage Sarutobi Hiruzen, and the person Naruto respects the most in his life.
desc_th: หนึ่งใน “3 นินจาในตำนาน” แห่งหมู่บ้านโคโนฮะ แคว้นไฟ ศิษย์ของโฮคาเงะรุ่นที่ 3 ซารุโทบิ ฮิรุเซ็น และเป็นบุคคลที่นารูโตะเคารพที่สุดในชีวิต
desc_in: Salah satu dari "Tiga Ninja Legendaris" Desa Daun, murid dari Hokage Ketiga Sarutobi Hiruzen, orang yang paling dihormati Naruto sepanjang hidupnya
desc_ph: Isa sa “Tatlong Alamat na Ninja” ng Nayon ng Dahon, alagad ni Hokage III Sarutobi Hiruzen, ang taong pinakagagalang ni Naruto sa buong buhay niya

name: Naruto Uzumaki (Sage Mode)
name_th: นารูโตะ อุซึมากิ (เซียน)
desc: Naruto created "Sage Chakra" by absorbing a certain amount of natural energy, significantly enhancing his ninjutsu, taijutsu, and genjutsu, and causing severe wounds to the Ten-Tails and its Jinchuriki.

desc_ma: Naruto mencipta "Chakra Senjutsu" dengan menyerap sejumlah tenaga semula jadi tertentu, memperkuat drastik ninjutsu, taijutsu, dan genjutsu dirinya, serta mampu menyebabkan luka parah sukar pulih kepada Bijuu Sepuluh Ekor dan Jinchuriki-nya.

desc_in: Naruto menciptakan “Chakra Sage Mode” dengan menyerap sejumlah energi alam tertentu, yang meningkatkan kekuatan ninjutsu, taijutsu, dan genjutsu secara signifikan, serta mampu menyebabkan luka parah pada Ekor Sepuluh dan Jinchuriki-nya
desc_ph: Ginamit ni Naruto ang "Senjutsu Chakra" sa pamamagitan ng pagsipsip ng likas na enerhiya, pinalalakas ang ninjutsu, taijutsu at genjutsu, kaya nitong magdulot ng malalalim na sugat sa Ten-Tails at Jinchuriki nito

name: Tsunade (Byakugo)
name_th: สึนาเดะ (บยาคุโก)
desc: The Strength of a Hundred Seal is an S-rank medical ninjutsu developed by the Fifth Hokage Tsunade. Upon activation, the seal spreads across the body, instantly beginning high-speed regeneration without interrupting attack rhythm.
desc_vn: Bách Hào chi thuật là một nhẫn thuật y thuật chiến đấu cấp S do Hokage đệ ngũ Tsunade phát triển, khi thi triển, chú ấn lan tỏa khắp cơ thể, ngay khi chịu sát thương sẽ bắt đầu tái sinh tự động tốc độ cao liên tục mà không ảnh hưởng đến nhịp độ tấn công.

desc_in: Byakugō no Jutsu adalah ninjutsu medis tingkat S yang dikembangkan oleh Hokage Kelima Tsunade, saat digunakan, segel menyebar ke seluruh tubuh dan secara otomatis meregenerasi luka dengan kecepatan tinggi tanpa mengganggu ritme serangan

desc: The Third Hokage of the Hidden Leaf Village, Fire Country, direct disciple of the Second Hokage Senju Tobirama, capable of mastering the combination of five chakra nature transformations, and proficient in all Leaf Village jutsu, known as the "Professor of Ninjutsu."

desc_en: The Third Hokage of the Hidden Leaf Village, Fire Country, direct disciple of the Second Hokage Senju Tobirama, capable of mastering the combination of five chakra nature transformations, and proficient in all Leaf Village jutsu, known as the "Professor of Ninjutsu."
